a.lede: The recalls come after the California DMV banned Waymo from operating on its state freeways.
a.title: Waymo recalls robotaxis after they drove into closed freeway lanes

b.lede: California’s DMV banned Waymo’s self-driving cars from freeways after determining that they pose “an imminent hazard to public safety.”
b.title: Waymo Pauses All Highway Rides After California Safety Ban
